WhatIf.description: Scenario changes applied before a plan is generated (PRD FR-19). Defaults change nothing.

AtRisk.description: One lot of stock held by a distributor that is expected to expire before it sells (PRD FR-20).

SpaceFit.description: How many more whole cases of one product fit in a node's free space.

SpaceNode.description: Storage at one depot store (ambient or chilled) or one distributor godown on a given morning. used_m3 counts stock on hand, plus stock in transit for a distributor. Depot capacity is supply.depot_storage_weeks x the region's weekly volume; a distributor's is its storage_m3.

temp_class.description: Store for a depot; null for a distributor godown (one space for all goods).

SpaceReport.description: Warehouse space across the network on one morning, after plant receipts and before dispatch.

Trajectory.description: Stock of one SKU at one distributor, day by day, for each policy in one experiment seed (PRD FR-21). Only seeds 1 and 2 keep sim logs.

OrderSummary.description: One distributor's order inside a plan: the proposal the distributor receives (PRD FR-08).

OrdersView.description: All orders of one plan version, with totals. draft_version is the first version of the plan, used for 'since draft'.

AssistantRequest.description: A sentence typed in the sidebar. Quantities are never taken from the model: the assistant only picks a tool from a fixed list.

AssistantStep.description: One tool the assistant ran (or refused to run), in order.

AssistantResponse.description: Result of one sidebar message. status needs_confirmation means an ask-first action is waiting for the user's confirm.

stock_counts.description: Counted stock that replaces the simulated quantity for each (node, product) before planning.

PairForecast.description:
Daily demand distribution for one SKU x distributor from `start` for len(mean) days.

Window demand over any span = sum of daily means / variances (days independent, A27).
Convert to a distribution with engine.dist.window_dist().

ForecastRow.description: Weekly row for the UI and backtest report.

EngineSettings.description: Weights plus ablation switches (FR-12). Default = full engine.

Lock.description: Constraint C10 on one arc (lot -> distributor).

Shortfall.description: Demand left unserved (FR-06: rows with zero shipment and a limiting code).

StockCount.description: Counted stock of one product at one depot or distributor. Replaces the simulated quantity for that pair before space is shown or a plan is made.

EngineSpaceRequest.description: Internal engine request: warehouse space on a morning with counted stock applied.

WhUser.description: A warehouse-app user. A depot or distributor user sees and changes only its own node; a planner sees every node.

Session.description: Returned by login. Send the token as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on every /v1/wh route.

MovementRequest.description: receipt: cases that arrived; count: cases counted on the shelf (replaces the system figure); adjust: signed change, e.g. -12 for damage.

WhStockRow.description: One lot (or one counted product) at the user's node, oldest expiry first.

WhOrder.description: A distributor's order from one plan sent today: the proposal message and its lines, as the distributor answers it in the app.

WhRespondRequest.description: A distributor's answer from the app. The distributor is the logged-in user; the backend fills it in.
